english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when one light, person, or performance visibly eclipses another.
This is the all-purpose choice when one thing dominates another and makes it seem less important.

examples.english: The fireworks show outshine all the other acts tonight.
examples.traditional: 今晚個煙花匯演蓋過晒其他節目的風頭。
examples.jyutping: gam1 maan5 go3 jin1 faa1 wui6 jin2 goi3 gwo3 saai3 kei4 taa1 zit3 muk6 dik1 fung1 tau4

examples.english: The special effects in this film overshadow the story itself.
examples.traditional: 呢套戲嘅特技效果蓋過咗劇情本身。
examples.jyutping: nei1 tou3 hei3 ge3 dak6 gei6 haau6 gwo2 goi3 gwo3 zo2 kek6 cing4 bun2 san1
